script: Some dinosaurs swallowed stones to help grind up their food. These stomach stones are called gastroliths. Psittacosaurus fossils have been found with piles of small stones inside their ribs. Birds like chickens still do the same thing today, using grit in their gizzards. Psittacosaurus means parrot lizard, because of its parrot-like beak. It was a small plant-eater, about 2 meters long, related to Triceratops. Follow DinoBytes for more prehistoric facts.
